host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo test -p athena-context brief 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test retry 2>&1
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo test -p xtask --test policy -q 2>&1; git status --short

policy_denials.detail: cd <job>/work; grep -rn "The request names these\|Your reading is refused unless" crates | head; sed -n 595,615p crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs; grep -n "pub struct RetryCause" -A32 crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs; sed -n 1,40p CHANGELOG.md; grep -n "^use\|EarlierAttempt" crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs | head -30
git -C <job>/work grep -n "RetryCause\|EarlierAttempt" -- crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs | head -5; git -C <job>/work grep -n "fn id(" -A4 -- crates/athena-core/src/store.rs
sed -i 's/20261110-000099-bbbb/20261110-000059-bbbb/g' crates/athena-core/src/reading/topics.rs && cargo test -p athena-core referenced 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |panicked|error"
cargo test -p athena-context brief 2>&1 | tail -30; cargo test -p athena-cli --test retry 2>&1 | tail -30

cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | grep -E "FAILED|failed|panicked|test result|error" ; cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets --test lifecycle 2>&1 | grep -E "FAILED|failed|panicked|test result|error"
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "x" 2>&1 | head -0; cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1
